result.brief: 提出基于混合Transformer的World-Language-Action统一模型，用世界专家预测未来场景动态、语言专家做语义理解、动作专家生成轨迹，并通过跨专家注意力对齐语义与动态表征。
result.reason: Unified world-language-action model with a World Expert for future scene prediction and cross-expert representation alignment; main contribution is driving planning, so world modeling is enabling.
